item.description:
Memonta 9.6.1（145）
- 修复系统音频和混合录音在权限申请尚未完成时立即报「未授权」的问题。启动等待 ScreenCaptureKit 的实际授权结果，混合录音在授权完成后才启动麦克风。 - 录屏沿用同一授权流程；保留系统权限校验，并增加授权等待超时、取消和迟到结果防护。 - 补齐屏幕录制与系统音频的权限用途说明，新增文案支持全部 21 种界面语言。 - 更新后若系统设置显示权限已开启却仍报错，提示重建当前版本的授权。
此版本仍使用未公证分发方式。临时签名不能保证跨版本保留 macOS 授权；系统要求时需要重新授权。长期保留权限需要稳定的 Developer ID 签名。
English
- Fixes system-audio and mixed recording reporting denied access before authorization finishes. Startup waits for the actual ScreenCaptureKit result; mixed recording starts the microphone only after authorization succeeds. - Applies the same authorization flow to screen recording, retaining system access checks and adding timeout, cancellation and late-result protection. - Adds screen-capture and system-audio purpose strings, with translations for all 21 UI languages. - Explains how to renew authorization if System Settings shows enabled access but the current app is still denied after an update.
This release remains non-notarized. Ad-hoc signing cannot guarantee macOS authorization continuity across versions; reauthorization may be required. A stable Developer ID signing identity is needed for long-term continuity.
